headline: Argentina Merval Slides 1.3% as Banks Fall and Country Risk Hits 763 bps
summary: Argentina’s Merval stock index dropped 1.30% to 95,438.89 as banking shares retreated and country risk widened to 763 basis points. The official exchange rate held at 1,560 pesos per dollar.
why: Argentina's financial markets are sensitive to sovereign credit spreads, domestic currency controls, and banking sector asset quality.

impacts.name: Argentine Banking
impacts.why: Rising country risk spreads tend to compress asset valuations and sovereign debt holdings of local banks.
